# phenix ui

<!-- Generated by `make cli-docs` from the phenix command tree. Do not edit. -->

Every command on this page also accepts the [global flags](index.md#options).

## phenix ui

Run the phenix UI

### Synopsis

```text
Run the phenix UI server

  Starts the UI server on the IP:port provided.
```

```text
phenix ui [flags]
```

### Options

```text
  -b, --base-path string              base path to use for UI (must run behind proxy if not '/') (default "/")
      --features strings              list of features to enable (options: vm-mount)
      --file-server-endpoint string   port or host:port to serve experiment file uploads on; port-only binds 127.0.0.1 (default "0")
  -h, --help                          help for ui
      --jwt-lifetime duration         Lifetime of JWT authentication tokens (default 24h0m0s)
  -k, --jwt-signing-key string        Secret key used to sign JWT for authentication
  -e, --listen-endpoint string        endpoint to listen on (default "0.0.0.0:3000")
      --log-requests                  Log HTTP requests
      --logs.level string             log level to publish to UI. Defaults to file level
      --logs.minimega-path string     path to minimega log file to publish to UI
      --minimega-console              enable minimega console access in UI
      --netflow.max-size int          maximum size in megabytes of each recorded netflow capture (0 does not record) (default 100)
      --proxy-auth-header string      header containing username when using proxy authentication
      --shutdown-grace-period int     how many seconds stopping the server may take to close connections and finish work (0 does not wait) (default 5)
      --tls-cert string               path to TLS cert file
      --tls-key string                path to TLS key file
      --unbundled                     serve local public files instead of bundled
      --users strings                 initial users to add, each as <username>:<password>:<role>[:<resource name>...] (comma-separated or repeated)
```
